Player leading on the mosque staircase
If still tied, the tied players share the victory.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Season scoring (3 times) is part of the track. Remaining-resources category: enter the sum of dinars, water, dates and goods keshis. Oases/Desert Towns belong to Expansion 5 and are entered as a total; other expansions not modelled.
